theme.name: Fashion & Textile Design
theme.audience: fashion designers, textile artists, costume designers, stylists
theme.market_anchor: the fashion design software market (~$1.2B) within a $2.5T global fashion industry

ideas.title: Fabric Storychain
ideas.pitch: Track textile origins transparently for designers and consumers to verify authenticity.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social enables seamless user authentication and gasless tracing of textile provenance.
ideas.som: $20M — early adopters in sustainable fashion brands

ideas.title: Moodboard Mint
ideas.pitch: Create and share moodboards that capture design inspirations with onchain credits and permissions.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social allows easy Google sign-in and sponsored tx to enable frictionless moodboard sharing.

ideas.title: TrendToken Vault
ideas.pitch: Collect and verify emerging fashion trends via community consensus and rewarded participation.
ideas.quantumRationale: Sponsored tx enable users to vote on trends without gas fees, increasing engagement.

ideas.title: PatternShare
ideas.pitch: Securely share and license digital sewing patterns with transparent ownership and usage rights.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy embedded wallet bootstrapped by PRIVY_APP_ID ensures seamless user access and transaction sponsorship.

ideas.title: ColorChain Palette
ideas.pitch: Verify and share color formula origins to protect designer intellectual property.
ideas.quantumRationale: Google sign-in and gasless transactions simplify tracking color data ownership onchain.

ideas.title: Wearable Royalties
ideas.pitch: Automatically distribute royalties for digital fashion assets across creators and brands.
ideas.quantumRationale: Sponsored transactions facilitate gas-free royalty payments triggered by user activity.

ideas.title: Runway Replay
ideas.pitch: Capture and timestamp runway shows for authenticity and replay rights management.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social login ensures easy user onboarding and timestamping without gas friction.

ideas.title: Sartorial Social
ideas.pitch: Connect fashion creatives with gasless transactions enabling easy contract signing and collaborations.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy embedded wallet with sponsored tx ensures smooth social interaction without gas barrier.

ideas.title: Fabric Fraction
ideas.pitch: Enable fractional ownership of rare textile swatches through secure tokenization and seamless onboarding.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy wallet with Google sign-in and sponsored tx minimizes user friction in fractional ownership.

ideas.title: Virtual Trychain
ideas.pitch: Authenticate virtual try-on sessions and purchases transparently for customers and brands.
ideas.quantumRationale: Onchain recording with gasless transactions prevents user drop-off during authentication.

ideas.title: Accessory Auth
ideas.pitch: Provide verified origin records for fashion accessories and fine jewelry owners.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social login and sponsored tx enable secure provenance recording and easy user access.

ideas.title: Capsule Contract
ideas.pitch: Enable designers to co-create and manage capsule collections with frictionless onchain agreements.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social plus sponsored tx simplifies contract setup and management without gas costs.

ideas.title: Style Stake
ideas.pitch: Stake tokens to support favorite designers and earn rewards through community votes.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy wallet with sponsored tx enables easy staking and reward distribution without user gas burden.

ideas.title: Fabric Swapchain
ideas.pitch: Decentralize textile swaps between designers via secure tokenized exchanges.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy embedded wallet and sponsored tx facilitate seamless trades without gas friction.

ideas.title: Runway Reward
ideas.pitch: Reward attendance and participation at fashion events with tokenized perks and proof of presence.
ideas.quantumRationale: Gasless tx encourages user engagement without friction during event check-ins.

ideas.title: Style Snapshot
ideas.pitch: Securely log daily outfits as NFTs with easy social sign-in and no gas cost.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social and sponsored tx let users mint outfit NFTs without blockchain experience.

ideas.title: Craft Credit
ideas.pitch: Automatically credit textile artisans in design chains with transparent onchain records.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy wallet and sponsored tx automate attribution without user gas concerns.

ideas.title: Pattern Provenance
ideas.pitch: Protect sewing patterns with immutable copyright records accessible via Google login.
ideas.quantumRationale: Gasless sponsored tx enable pattern creators to register rights affordably and easily.

ideas.title: Tailor Token
ideas.pitch: Enable tailors to accept and manage custom orders via tokenized contracts and gasless sign-in.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy embedded wallet with sponsored tx reduces friction for small business adoption.

ideas.title: Fashion DAO Hub
ideas.pitch: Empower designer collectives to govern projects through token voting with easy wallet setup.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social plus gasless transactions lower barriers for DAO participation in fashion niches.

ideas.title: Vintage Vault
ideas.pitch: Authenticate vintage fashion pieces via onchain certificates linked to verified user profiles.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy Google sign-in and sponsored tx enable user-friendly provenance verification.

ideas.title: Style Swap
ideas.pitch: Facilitate safe swaps of clothing items with secure tokenized agreements and zero gas fees.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy wallet plus sponsored tx encourage user trades by removing blockchain friction.

ideas.title: Textile Tokenizer
ideas.pitch: Convert physical textile assets into digital tokens for trading and provenance tracking.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy embedded wallet simplifies token creation and sponsored tx removes cost barriers.

ideas.title: Designer Direct
ideas.pitch: Connect designers directly with suppliers using onchain verified transactions and profiles.
ideas.quantumRationale: Privy social login and gasless tx simplify supply chain verification and reduce intermediaries.

ideas.title: Capsule Claim
ideas.pitch: Issue onchain certificates for limited edition capsule collections ensuring buyer confidence.
ideas.quantumRationale: Google sign-in with sponsored tx allows secure certificate minting without gas hurdles.
